resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Eastern US Lookouts copy of the NGS datasheet says the station was described in 1967; the official NGS datasheet says 1966. The story follows the official datasheet.

notes_for_editor: Record point 34.91713, -89.24682 is roughly 25-30 m from the NGS station (NAD 83 34 55 00.84 N, 089 14 48.81 W). The datasheet puts the tower 100 ft north of the station, so the point is consistent with the tower; no correction proposed. The datasheet's 'height of light above station mark' (26 m) is a light height, not a tower height, and is not used. The survey marks are stamped LAMAR 1966, so the datasheet designation is LAMAR, not Aldarge. No build date, staffing, or removal date is in any source. Access today is unknown; the site was state property in 1966 but nothing current was found. Both searches for the name returned nothing relevant.
